meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 拿到蛋白质序列后,Claude 能找出可能的 N-糖基化位点、预测 O-糖基化热点,可对序列做去掉或加上糖基化位点的修改,并给出 NetOGlyc 等在线工具的使用指引。
howto.when: 当用户提供蛋白质序列,或提到糖基化、抗体优化、疫苗设计等话题时触发。

say.text: 扫描这条蛋白序列,列出所有 N-糖基化位点。
say.note: Claude 会返回位点位置、基序和上下文。

say.text: 把第 85 位的 N 换成 Q,去除那个糖基化位点。
给我 NetOGlyc 的网址和用法,我要预测 O-糖基化。
say.note: Claude 会提供工具链接和提交步骤。

howto.what_en: Given a protein sequence, Claude scans for N-glycosylation sequons, predicts O-glycosylation hotspots, can edit sites (add/remove), and points to tools like NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, and GlycoWorkbench.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user provides a protein sequence or mentions glycosylation, antibody optimization, vaccine design, or similar glycoprotein engineering topics.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence and list all N-glycosylation sites.
say_en.note: Claude returns positions, motifs, and context.

say_en.text: Replace Asn at position 85 with Gln to remove that glycosylation site.
Give me the NetOGlyc URL and instructions for O-glycosylation prediction.
say_en.note: Claude provides the link and submission steps.
